descriptorText:
Level 2  
 
Candidates at this level typically  
 
 Understand literal spoken English when delivered at moderate speed in familiar accents in 
familiar si tuations, and are able to distinguish fact from opinion when this is clearly signalled 
and the context is simple and familiar.  
 Understand simple texts if the topic is familiar, and are able to follow parts of the development 
of an explicit argument and identify opinions when they are clearly signalled, work out the 
meaning of unfamiliar words when a simple and familiar context is given, following simple 
written instructions to locate and transfer some information relevant to a given task.  
 Make some re levant points in writing, organized in a straightforward way using simple sentence 
structures and simple vocabulary accurately, and showing some awareness of features of genre.  
 Use a small range of short and simple common expressions with fluency, prono uncing familiar 
words comprehensibly, and responding to others when prompted.
